title: Prannoy Advances to Indonesia Masters Round of 16; Kharb, Chaliha Also Win
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Prannoy secured a spot in the round of 16, with fellow Indians Kharb and Chaliha also registering wins.
summary: World No. 39 Prannoy defeated Liao 18-21, 21-15, 21-19 in an hour and four minutes at the Indonesia Masters Super 100, where he will next face China’s Xuan Chen Zhu. Kharb and Chaliha also advanced.

title: Lakshya Sen Exits China Masters Early, Srikanth Advances
indian_angle: While Lakshya Sen faced an early exit, Kidambi Srikanth successfully progressed to the next round at the China Masters.
summary: Lakshya Sen suffered his third defeat to a Canadian opponent, marking another early exit, while Kidambi Srikanth secured his passage to the next stage of the China Masters.

title: Prannoy Progresses to Indonesia Masters Super 100 Round of 16
indian_angle: India's Prannoy secured a hard-fought victory to advance to the next round of the Indonesia Masters Super 100.
summary: World No. 39 Prannoy overcame Liao with a score of 18-21, 21-15, 21-19 in an intense match lasting over an hour, moving into the round of 16.
